nodes.description: Mapping of address to token balance, mutated in transfer, transferFrom, mint and burn.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount used by approve, transferFrom and allowance mutators.
Total token supply, set in constructor and mutated by mint and burn.
Token name string set once in the constructor.
Token symbol string set once in the constructor.
Privileged owner address set in constructor and checked by mint.
Deploys the token, mints the entire supply to msg.sender and records the owner.
View getter returning _name.
View getter returning _symbol.
View getter returning the hard-coded value 10.
View getter returning _totalSupply.
View getter returning the balance of a supplied account.
External transfer that debits msg.sender and credits recipient without allowance checks.
View getter returning the allowance for an owner/spender pair.
Sets the allowance of a spender for msg.sender; no zero-first check.
Debits allowance and sender balance then credits recipient; emits Transfer.
Increases the spender allowance of msg.sender by addedValue.
Decreases the spender allowance of msg.sender, clamping to zero on underflow.
Owner-only mint that credits a user and increases _totalSupply.
Burns tokens from msg.sender and reduces _totalSupply.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, balance holder and authorization subject.
Unchecked decrement of _balances[msg.sender] by an arbitrary amount inside transfer.
require(msg.sender == _owner) authorization gate in mint; single point of privileged access.
Decrements _allowances[sender][msg.sender] and _balances[sender] then credits recipient without a validation of allowance sufficiency beyond checked math.
Decrements _balances[msg.sender] and _totalSupply by amount inside burn.
Additive mutation of _allowances[msg.sender][spender] by addedValue.
Subtractive mutation of the spender allowance with an explicit clamp branch.
Constructor argument name_ assigned to _name.
Constructor argument symbol_ assigned to _symbol.
Constructor argument totalSupply scaled by 10**10 and credited to deployer.
Account whose balance is read by balanceOf.
Recipient credited inside transfer.
Amount debited and credited inside transfer.
Owner whose allowance is read by allowance.
Spender whose allowance is read by allowance.
Spender granted an allowance by approve.
Allowance value written by approve.
Account debited by transferFrom.
Account credited by transferFrom.
Amount moved by transferFrom.
Spender whose allowance is increased.
Delta added to the spender allowance.
Spender whose allowance is decreased.
Delta subtracted from the spender allowance.
Account credited by mint.
Amount minted to user and added to _totalSupply.
Amount removed from msg.sender balance and _totalSupply.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter name_ is stored into _name.
Constructor parameter symbol_ is stored into _symbol.
Constructor parameter totalSupply drives the initial supply and balance.
balanceOf reads _balances at the account index.
recipient identifies the credited balance entry.
amount is subtracted from and added to balances in transfer.
owner indexes the allowance lookup.
spender indexes the allowance lookup.
spender is the allowance key written by approve.
amount is the allowance value written by approve.
sender is the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
recipient is the credited account in transferFrom.
amount drives three balance/allowance arithmetic mutations in transferFrom.
spender is the allowance key increased in increaseAllowance.
addedValue is added to the allowance entry.
spender is the allowance key decreased in decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is subtracted from the allowance entry under a comparison guard.
user is the account credited by mint.
amount is added to both _balances[user] and _totalSupply.
amount is subtracted from _balances[msg.sender] and _totalSupply in burn.
msg.sender becomes _owner and receives the entire initial supply.
msg.sender selects both the debited balance and approving identity in transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance written in approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner mutated by increaseAllowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner mutated by decreaseAllowance.
require(msg.sender == _owner) gates mint; the caller controls the authorization check.
msg.sender is the account burned from in burn.
Constructor credits _balances[msg.sender] with the scaled total supply.
Constructor writes the scaled value into _totalSupply.
Constructor stores the name string.
Constructor stores the symbol string.
Constructor sets _owner to msg.sender, establishing privileged authority.
name returns _name.
symbol returns _symbol.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads _balances.
allowance reads _allowances.
transfer subtracts from and adds to _balances entries.
transfer reaches the unchecked sender balance debit.
approve writes the caller-controlled allowance entry.
transferFrom decrements the allowance that authorizes the transfer.
transferFrom debits sender and credits recipient balances.
transferFrom reaches the allowance and balance decrements.
increaseAllowance adds to an allowance entry.
increaseAllowance reaches the additive allowance mutation.
decreaseAllowance conditionally subtracts from an allowance entry.
decreaseAllowance reaches the clamped subtractive mutation.
mint credits _balances[user].
mint increases _totalSupply.
mint is gated by the owner equality check on msg.sender.
_owner is read as the authorization reference in mint.
burn decrements _balances[msg.sender].
burn decrements _totalSupply.
burn reaches the balance and supply decrements.
